nodes.label: Linux capture provider input-density gate
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-snipset/2026-09-25 - audit-linux-activity-capture-path [ses_f2593177dffebmwf7DKUz8dQjY].md:L8083] Answer to the question: not a stub returning 0 — never emitted. The value is genuinely accumulated in the static and never read. The Linux branch hardcodes input_density: None at capture_provider.rs:158 while the only read of INPUT_TRACKER in the entire tree is capture_provider.rs:91, inside the #[cfg(target_os = "windows")] block.

nodes.label: A missing foreground helper binary degrades to a completely silent empty result
nodes.norm_label: a missing foreground helper binary degrades to a completely silent empty result
nodes.summary: capture_command_output (utils/window.rs:60-67) discards the io::Error from a missing PATH entry with .ok(), discards a non-zero exit with .filter, and throws away stderr. The failure surfaces only as Ok(None), which worker.rs:113-116 consumes by writing a DB row and logging nothing. Verified: zero log/tracing statements in utils/window.rs.
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-snipset/2026-09-25 - audit-linux-activity-capture-path [ses_f2593177dffebmwf7DKUz8dQjY].md:L8050] So a missing helper binary produces no log line, no error, no counter, no UI signal — only runtime_health.activity_status='idle', last_error_code='no_active_window' in SQLite. This is asserted as intended behaviour by utils/window.rs:43-45 and by the tests x11_missing_tools_degrade_to_none and wayland_prefers_kdotool_and_absent_tool_means_none.

nodes.label: A nil input_density makes every Linux capture tick classify as AFK
nodes.norm_label: a nil input_density makes every linux capture tick classify as afk
nodes.summary: worker.rs:129-132 computes is_afk as sample.input_density.map(|id| id.keystrokes == 0 && id.mouse_events == 0).unwrap_or(true). Since input_density is always None on Linux, the unwrap_or arm is taken on every tick.
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-snipset/2026-09-25 - audit-linux-activity-capture-path [ses_f2593177dffebmwf7DKUz8dQjY].md:L8150] The only escape is worker.rs:134-140 check_face_presence(), and webcam_presence.rs:21 unconditionally returns Ok(false). So every Linux tick is classified AFK, always, which drives the cadence and, via the queue, prevents any journal generation at all (worker_manager.rs:182 if !pending_items.is_empty()).

nodes.label: Derived-session derivation starves because screenshot gating empties the processing queue
nodes.norm_label: derived session derivation starves because screenshot gating empties the processing queue
nodes.summary: derive_focus_session has exactly one production call site (worker.rs:250), which sits after the early return at worker.rs:242-244 on an empty pending queue. Queue rows are only created at worker.rs:199-204, gated on screenshot_ref_hash and screenshot_payload — both hardcoded None on Linux.
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-snipset/2026-09-25 - audit-linux-activity-capture-path [ses_f2593177dffebmwf7DKUz8dQjY].md:L8105] No helper installed is not the relevant failure — the failure is structural (no screenshots means no queue means no derive pass), and it is identical whether kdotool is present or not.

nodes.label: An idle capture tick resets the AFK counter and pins the worker at its fastest interval
nodes.norm_label: an idle capture tick resets the afk counter and pins the worker at its fastest interval
nodes.summary: The no-sample case returns ActivityWorkerTickReport::default() whose is_afk is bool::default(), i.e. false. The adaptive interval logic at worker_manager.rs:296-321 therefore treats the idle state as active: afk_ticks resets to 0 and current_interval stays at 15 s indefinitely.
rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-snipset/2026-09-25 - audit-linux-activity-capture-path [ses_f2593177dffebmwf7DKUz8dQjY].md:L08183] On a machine with no `kdotool`/`xprop`, Linux spins at 15 s indefinitely, re-opening the encrypted DB twice per tick (`worker_manager.rs:125` and `:229`) and re-resolving the vision model (`:172`).

nodes.label: The Linux webview playback route bypasses the inline IFrame fixes the plans targeted
nodes.norm_label: the linux webview playback route bypasses the inline iframe fixes the plans targeted
nodes.summary: Commit f1c0fb020 added requiresYoutubeWebview() (TauriAdapter.ts:124-128, matching /Linux|X11/i), so on Linux the inline IFrame path that plans 1 and 3 target is never reached. The AC-level code and tests can all pass while the Linux behaviour the plan exists to fix is untouched.
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar/2026-09-26 - assess-3-linux-audio-plans [ses_f208d0ac1ffeRd3uR5eK8XPmxF].md:L6501] The goal was Linux diagnosability, and on Linux requiresYoutubeWebview() is true, so initYouTubePlayer/onError are not reached at all. Which error a Linux user now sees was not checked — verifying needs a real Linux WebKitGTK run.

nodes.label: The 24/7 lofi streams expose audio only over HLS, which WebKitGTK cannot play, so no direct stream was ever produced
nodes.norm_label: the 24 7 lofi streams expose audio only over hls which webkitgtk cannot play so no direct stream was ever produced
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar/2026-09-26 - assess-3-linux-audio-plans [ses_f208d0ac1ffeRd3uR5eK8XPmxF].md:L6602] The yt-dlp resolve path was removed on 2026-09-26. Measured against real search results, the 24/7 lofi streams expose audio only over HLS, which WebKitGTK cannot play, so no direct stream was ever produced and every attempt cost a subprocess before falling through anyway. Commit c9dbef41e: refactor(pomodoro): drop the yt-dlp resolve path, it never produced a stream.

nodes.label: A runbook documents a code path the application no longer calls
nodes.norm_label: a runbook documents a code path the application no longer calls
nodes.summary: docs/troubleshooting/youtube-linux-audio.md:30-32 tells operators the second route resolves an audio-only stream URL in Rust and hands it to HTMLAudioElement. The application no longer has that route.
rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar/2026-09-26 - assess-3-linux-audio-plans [ses_f208d0ac1ffeRd3uR5eK8XPmxF].md:L06598] The document tells operators to install `yt-dlp` for a feature the app will never invoke. This is the concrete harm of marking this plan done.

nodes.label: A pre-existing failing baseline makes an exit-0 acceptance gate unmeetable as written
nodes.norm_label: a pre-existing failing baseline makes an exit 0 acceptance gate unmeetable as written
nodes.summary: The progress log records a pre-existing src/__contract__/ baseline of 2 failed / 62 passed (repository-layout, updater-platform). An AC worded as contract suite exit 0 therefore cannot be met literally, independent of the work under review.
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar/2026-09-26 - assess-3-linux-audio-plans [ses_f208d0ac1ffeRd3uR5eK8XPmxF].md:L6539] So contract suite exit 0 as the plan words it is not achievable and was not met as literally written.

nodes.label: A regression from overlapping background writes passes the whole test suite
nodes.norm_label: a regression from overlapping background writes passes the whole test suite
nodes.summary: A parent session edited TtsLiveDemoCard.tsx while a T1 subagent was still running. The subagent's later write reverted the parent's browserCanSpeak change, and git add -A swept the regression into the commit. Both variants pass all 9 tests.
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar/2026-09-26 - assess-3-linux-audio-plans [ses_f208d0ac1ffeRd3uR5eK8XPmxF].md:L6550] A real regression once passed the whole suite; the suite is not sufficient evidence on its own. It was caught by reading the committed file after the T1 report arrived, not by any test.

nodes.label: A plan status verdict needs verifiable evidence, not ticked checkboxes
nodes.norm_label: a plan status verdict needs verifiable evidence not ticked checkboxes
nodes.summary: All three plans declared status: Draft and each had a commit touching the plan file, yet one was PARTIAL, one PARTIAL, and one UNFINISHED with its central task deliberately reverted. A commit that touches a plan file records that the file changed, not that any acceptance criterion was met.
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar/2026-09-26 - assess-3-linux-audio-plans [ses_f208d0ac1ffeRd3uR5eK8XPmxF].md:L6466] Every criterion whose only proof is a green run is marked UNVERIFIED regardless of what a progress log claims. Code that exists is evidence the work started; it is not evidence the criterion was met on a real machine.
